errors.text_span: Der Wertebereich der y-Achse reicht von -8 zu 6
errors.evidence: The y-axis range shown in the figure is from -7 to 3, not -8 to 6.
The line in the chart is a simple solid line and does not have any markers, let alone small triangular ones.

errors.text_span: Die Linie beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 1 Euro/MWh im April 2024
errors.evidence: The line begins at a value of approximately 2 Euro/MWh in April 2024, not 1.

errors.text_span: steigt allmählich auf etwa 2 Euro/MWh im Mai 2024 an, bevor sie bis Juni 2024 um etwa 1,8 Euro/MWh abfällt
errors.evidence: The line is already at approximately 2 Euro/MWh at the start in April and fluctuates around that level. It does not rise to 2 in May, nor does it drop by 1.8 by June; it remains above 1 Euro/MWh in June.

errors.text_span: verliert dann an Wert bis September 2024 auf unter 1 Euro/MWh
errors.evidence: In September 2024, the value of the line is still clearly above 1 Euro/MWh. It only drops below 1 Euro/MWh in late October 2024.
The line reaches its minimum of approximately -6 Euro/MWh in January 2025, not December 2024. In December 2024, the value is between 0 and -3 Euro/MWh.

errors.text_span: bevor sie bis Februar 2025 auf 5 Euro/MWh ansteigt
errors.evidence: The line ends at approximately -2 Euro/MWh in February 2025, not 5 Euro/MWh.
